**This is process data (an experiment log), not a design
reference** — nothing here binds kernel design; it moves out of
`docs/` when the experiment concludes.

Standing experiment (Ev, in-chat, 2026-09-23), opened the day the
model A/B protocol was suspended (`docs/MODEL-AB-LOG.md`, the
suspension entry). **The protocol in force lives in
`docs/DUAL-REVIEW-PROTOCOL.md`.** Each row names the protocol it was
recorded under by commit hash, so `git show
<hash>:docs/DUAL-REVIEW-PROTOCOL.md` reads that version. Ev's rulings
on the readouts are in `docs/dual-review-log/rulings.md`.

**This file is generated.** Each row is one file,
`docs/dual-review-log/rows/PR-<n>.md`; its DR number is assigned on main
in merge order, and the foot is computed from the rows' front matter
(`scripts/dual-review-log.py`).

## Rows

Columns: **protocol** (commit hash of the protocol in force at merge — the last
commit on main that touched `docs/DUAL-REVIEW-PROTOCOL.md`); **unit** (program, PR); **class** (difficulty letter and task
class, logged at spec time; the arm, and for an M- or S-letter unit
the draw byte, per protocol rule 1) and the **triage reason**; **head** (the
frozen commit); **R1** and **R2** (verdict, MAJ/MIN/NOTE, one line of
prose per MAJOR, tokens, wall-clock); **correspondence** (bilateral
headline; unilateral findings R1→ and R2→; severity divergence);
**tally** (candidates, with the 6(a)–(e) disposition of each);
**fair** (yes, or the relaxation / interruption that excludes it);
**fix pass** (size, and who executed it).

## Later escapes

- **Later escape, DR-11 (PR 3265):** a torus face meeting a partner only in a face-interior oval WHILE crossings exist elsewhere (a half donut and a C-bracket) made `union` return a valid body with the lens counted twice. Neither review raised it; both raised the no-crossings instance (R2's tallied MAJOR). Found 2026-09-28 by GERM's torus-ops lane (PR 3330's measurement) and fixed by the stopgap PR 3336. The sphere analogue, found alongside it, predates PR 3265.
- **Later escape, DR-54 (PR 3805):** H / TRICKY, concurrent pair. Its first fix pass (`31116eeaee`) made the certified subdivision answer the degree-2 doors in the half-angle ladder's place, keeping only the ladder's escalations, and handed the subdivision no root-slack meter, so the ladder's `root_slack` was still decided but no longer read (`0f74dfdb7e`, a later fix pass, removed it as dead code). From then on the circle × torus door and the conic × quadric door's sphere and wall ladder arm certified shallow-crossing roots that read ON the surface but lie along the carrier up to 1.66e-9 m (166 bands) from the truth at ε 1e-12: 321 wrong of 9,000 circle × torus poses outside the band, 123 of 3,000 conic × quadric poses. No review raised it: the pair reviewed the head before that fix pass (R2's fuzz found 0 misplaced roots there); the first delta review, on the fix pass's head, judged the subdivision "sound as far as the input it is given" and did not meter its roots against the truth along the carrier; the second saw the ladder's `root_slack` discarded only as style ("`half_angle_roots` throws all of it away"). Found 2026-10-08 by GERM's circle × torus measurement lane and fixed by PR 4357 (`circle-torus-certifies-shallow-roots-off-by-more-than-the-band`).
- **Later escape, DR-200 (PR 4791):** M / STRUCTURAL, arm HOLDOUT. Seven `probe`-feature rows (`m8_f67_r1_probes` ×2, `span_meter_dim_twins` ×5) went red at the lane-free door.
